findings.evidence: R3 defines compatibility for undeclared publishers on unowned pairs, and AC44 verifies delivery, rejection when ownership is assigned, and unchanged shipped-profile behaviour.
AC20 adds allowlisted E, explicitly absent from inventory, and requires refused instance_action_missing with zero request frames.
AC43 covers chat-message fixtures and every documented notice mapping for twitch, kick and youtube, including rejection of unmapped notices and unowned-platform events.
R5 rejects duplicate entries, gives explicit action schemas precedence over group schemas, and requires every matching group schema otherwise; AC45 verifies these rules.

planning_assessment: The revised specification is sound enough to plan an implementation from.
